plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Farm Direct uses your location only while you are using the app, to show how far farms, stalls and markets are from you.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Farm Direct uses your location only while you are using the app, to show how far farms, stalls and markets are from you. It never tracks you in the background.

plugins.photosPermission: Farm Direct needs your photos so you can add pictures of your farm, stall or produce to your listing.
plugins.cameraPermission: Farm Direct uses your camera so you can take pictures of your farm, stall or produce for your listing.
